gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-gantari: Gantari looks bent from wire, with wide, welcoming c shapes. Shantell Sans is the showier one, cutting a loose, fixed-nib line with mouths like a tin can's lid, while the body does the quiet, steady work.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-gotu: Playful marker swagger up top, with r, n and m arches that match their stems. Gotu follows in thin strokes that taper gently yet stay sturdy, so paragraphs hold together.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-gowun-dodum: Loose, handmade, and a bit cheeky up top. Gowun Dodum settles in beneath it with a wide-mouthed a and smooth, tube-like lines, giving Shantell Sans a sensible sans-serif partner to play against.
